message.content:
This document is a technical README/study for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for running large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) on consumer and prosumer hardware. Key technical points:

**Models & Quantization**
- Maya ships its own quants (XS/S/M/L tiers by expert bit-width) of GLM-5.3-Flash (320B params, 18B active), with measured accuracy retention (97.7–99.2% of FP8
